title: ClientClosed payload
description: The reader closed the stream before its last event; no further model or tool call is made, and the answer opens no review item. A model call in flight when the reader left runs to its reply or `max_seconds`, and the answer keeps its `max_in_flight` slot until it ends. `steps` counts the model calls made, and the token counts add up their `usage` as `cortex.ask.AskDone` does; `context_tokens` is the prompt tokens of the last one.
